purpose: Validate online budgets, telemetry, output review binding and gold-context diagnostics on known provisional dev cases.
selection_reason: Preselected known dev diagnostics covering semantic, exploration, bridge variants, content/filename exact, read, absent/partial/ambiguous evidence and no retrieval; not a representative sample.
order: Rotate arms by case position; all Agent runs finish before synthesis or judge model switching.
budget_policy: No budget-specific prompt or controller feedback. Stop before over-limit calls; withhold whole over-limit tool observations. Caps are evaluator configuration, independent of gold.
time_policy: Cooperative deadline over the Agent loop; synchronous in-flight requests cannot be cancelled and may finish after the deadline. Setup and total runner time are separately recorded.
evidence_counter: Pinned repository embedding tokenizer, runtime fingerprint recorded; sum excerpt content tokens including repeats. JSON request reference counts are not provider prompt tokens.
judge_scope: The two fixed-synthesis conditions for the preselected case, correctness/support separate; no retries, no trusted semantic scores without independent human calibration.
claims: Engineering diagnostics only. Single trial, provisional labels, no matched cold/warm timing, no production or superiority claim.
